title: Inference for High-Dimensional Sparse Spectral Precision Matrices
abstract: arXiv:2606.07986v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Statistical inference for the spectral precision matrix at a given frequency allows us to assess frequency-specific conditional relationships among the components of a stationary multivariate time series. Compared with classical analogues, inference in the spectral domain is more challenging due to the absence of closed-form asymptotic variance expressions for complex-valued estimators, the limited asymptotic theory in high-dimensional settings, and the presence of truncation and smoothing biases in finite samples. We construct a debiased complex graphical lasso estimator at any fixed frequency by leveraging the full likelihood structure of neighboring discrete Fourier transforms. Using asymptotic distributions for bilinear forms of stationary multivariate time series, we establish the joint asymptotic normality of the real and imaginary parts of the debiased estimator. translated_title: 高维稀疏谱精度矩阵的推断
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2606.07986v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：在给定频率下对谱精度矩阵进行统计推断，使我们能够评估平稳多元时间序列各分量之间特定频率的条件关系。与经典类比方法相比，谱域中的推断更具挑战性，原因在于复值估计量缺乏渐近方差的闭式表达式、高维设置下渐近理论有限，以及有限样本中存在截断和平滑偏差。我们通过利用相邻离散傅里叶变换的完整似然结构，在任何固定频率下构建了一个去偏的复图拉索估计量。利用平稳多元时间序列双线性形式的渐近分布，我们建立了去偏估计量实部和虚部的联合渐近正态性。我们的主要理论贡献包括推导出闭式...
tldr: 本文提出了一种去偏的复图拉索估计量，用于高维谱精度矩阵推断，并建立了其联合渐近正态性，解决了谱域推断中缺乏闭式方差和高维理论不足的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a debiased complex graphical lasso estimator for high-dimensional spectral precision matrix inference, establishing joint asymptotic normality and addressing the lack of closed-form variance and high-dimensional theory in the spectral domain.
